verdict.rationale: Bruno stores API requests as collections in filesystem folders, and the docs reference folder-level configuration ("any request, folder, or collection"). Collections can be rerun anytime with the Bruno CLI, locally, in Docker, or in CI. Community users confirm that collections are saved as files and shared. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation on creating and nesting folders inside collections, and documentation of rerunning collections or folders from the in-app GUI runner.

support.subject: As a developer, I can organize API requests into collections and folders and rerun them anytime

citations.quote: Bruno stores your collections directly in a folder on your filesystem. We use a plain text markup language, Bru, to save information about API requests.
Open the Scripts tab on any request, folder, or collection.
With Bruno CLI, you can run your API collections with ease using simple command line commands.
Run your collections in Docker, GitHub Actions, and other pipelines.
